summary: Implementation plan for Prompt 4: Advanced AI/ML Health Intelligence Engine for SPACE HEALTH MONITO. Details the Python ML service, Isolation Forest anomaly detection, multi-variate statistical engine, time-series trend analysis, spaceflight context engine, Explainable AI (XAI) 5-point explanations, personalized health baseline comparisons across Before/During/After mission phases, and integration into the existing Express and React architecture.
